name: analytics
description: Instructor+ per-course analytics AND reader insight: completion counts, badge count, member count, quiz stats, the per-course drop-off funnel, and the community's weekly pulse. Derived aggregates over shared tables plus the insight feature's materiViews roll-up; bounded takes; instructor aggregate outputs contain no PII. One write (recordView) via MateriViewRecorder. Reader numbers count logged-in members only. Admin-only platform learning inventory/activity, daily trends and comparable exportable tables with honest completeness. Separate first-party website traffic dashboard with 7/30-day temporary-session analysis and honest unknowns. 0.5.0 adds administrator-only identity-level account details, guarded authenticated activity and honest loaded-page search.
notes: 0.3.0 (2026-08-11): reader insight folded in. The slice now spans TWO convex features (analytics + insight) because it is ONE screen; splitting the UI would make an instructor cross-reference two lists of the same materi by eye. CourseAnalyticsView DROPPED LessonCompletionBars in favour of FunnelStepList (same materi, same order, strictly more data) — the component stays exported for a consumer without the insight feature. recharts is code-split behind next/dynamic and renders ONE chart (the retention curve, the only value here that is a shape rather than a number); MIN_POINTS=3 keeps it from drawing a two-dot line. biggestDrop ranks by PEOPLE, not percent — see __tests__/dropoff.test.ts. Reader counts are members-only and MembersOnlyNote is a component so the caveat cannot be dropped from a third surface. 0.2.0 (2026-08-10): DECISIONS #37 materi model — LessonCompletionStat lost moduleId/moduleTitle (flat, ordered by courseLessons.order) and ModuleQuizStat became CourseQuizStat. 0.1.0 (2026-07-10, agent gamma): wave v1.2 scope of STATUS row #17. Owns ZERO tables — reads the shared memberships/lessons/courseLessons/lessonCompletions/courseCompletions/quizzes/quizAttempts tables directly (sanctioned precedent: progress/profiles shared-table reads). courseCompletions has no by_course index, so badge counts derive per CURRENT member via by_user (exact, bounded; ex-members' badges uncounted) — by_course index proposed to alpha. toPercent consumed via the progress BARREL (extract-on-second-occurrence: util shared by two slices; shared/ is integrator-only surface). 0.4.0: PlatformAnalyticsView is enabled only after host authorization and additionally skips until Convex auth is ready. Source completeness and count exactness remain visible, periods use WIB, and aggregate CSV protects spreadsheet formulas. Tenant analytics are preserved. Traffic view shares no learner-identity data and keeps masked temporary browser sessions distinct from people; country/city unknown remains unknown; local DB-IP City Lite GeoIP is approximate and carries source attribution, and earliest retained event is not claimed as instrumentation start. 0.5.0: identity-level account data is isolated behind requirePlatformAdmin and gated views. Anonymous visitor analytics remains separate, with no retrospective account linkage. CSV exports only displayed users or source-limited learning rows and keeps formula protection. Authenticated click targets are text, never arbitrary executable links.
